connector.name: Ozon Seller MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Ozon Seller API. 26 tools: products, prices, orders, analytics, finance, rating.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-ozon-seller. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the woyaxnini account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OZON_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Ozon seller numeric ID. Find it in your Ozon Seller cabinet: Settings → API integrations → Seller API.

env.name: OZON_API_KEY
env.description: Ozon Seller API key (UUID). Generate it in your Ozon Seller cabinet: Settings → API integrations → Seller API. Recommended role: Admin.
